verdict.rationale: Riveter is a SaaS web-scraping and enrichment platform, so team sharing, organizations, and role-based permissions are a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers enrichment, scraping, webhooks, SDKs, MCP, and scheduling. Nothing in it mentions sharing scrapers with teammates, organization management, or role-based access control.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share scrapers with teammates and manage organizations and role-based permissions
